people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”
translations.bsb: Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”
